description: This PHP source file defines a class 'OA_Maintenance_Priority_AdServer_Task_GetRequiredAdImpressionsDaily' that calculates the required number of ad impressions for campaigns with daily targets, specifically for campaigns with manual daily limits. It includes methods to retrieve valid campaigns and estimate impression requirements based on campaign data.

classes.name: OA_Maintenance_Priority_AdServer_Task_GetRequiredAdImpressionsDaily
classes.description: A class to calculate the number of required ad impressions for campaigns with daily targets, considering manual limits and campaign activity status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the class and sets the type to 'a daily target is set'.

methods.name: _getValidCampaigns
methods.description: Retrieves all active campaigns with priority >= 1 and daily inventory requirements, filtering based on campaign status and expiration conditions.

methods.name: getCampaignImpressionInventoryRequirement
methods.description: Estimates the impressions needed to fulfill a campaign's daily impression, click, or conversion requirement by calling the parent method.
